rules.text: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery or purchase.
rules.quote: If you’re not completely satisfied, most items can be returned within **30 days of delivery or purchase**.

rules.text: Items purchased in store must be returned to a Macy’s store.
rules.quote: Items purchased in store must be returned to a Macy’s store

rules.text: Returns in store are always free.
rules.reviewNote: The summary specifies 'returns in store are always free,' but the quote says 'returns are always free' without limiting it to in-store returns. The summary adds a restriction not present in the quote.

rules.text: Items purchased online can be returned in store or by mail.
rules.quote: Items purchased online can be returned **in store or by mail**

rules.text: Refunds are issued to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: Refunds are issued to your **original form of payment**

rules.text: Jewelry and watches require an inspection before refund is processed.
rules.quote: Some items (like jewelry and watches) require an **inspection before refund is processed**
